title: Month 6 Day 28

items.label: Yeshua the Firstborn: Firstfruits & the Seventieth Week
The River of Fire: Vesuvius, Titus & the Fifth Trumpet

notes:
This teaching opens with the duty of man to fear Yahweh and keep His commands, then returns to the Book of the Law and the Sabbatical year, focusing on the firstborn offerings of Deuteronomy 15. It places Yeshua inside that command as the Firstborn, the Bread of Life, and the Firstborn from the dead, connecting the Last Supper, the New Covenant, and the call to feast on the Word. The second portion reviews Deuteronomy 16 and the appointed times, then walks through 1 Corinthians 15 and the order of the resurrection. It closes with the visual timelines from Creation to Yeshua’s return, the 40 years of Acts plus the 7 years of Revelation, and an introduction to Daniel’s seventieth week and the 3.5-year Great Tribulation.

This teaching connects Daniel’s river of fire to the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in the first century, examining Josephus, the rise of Titus in the Flavian dynasty, and the coins that titled him Caesar. It then reads Revelation 8–9 against the eyewitness letters of Pliny and the destruction in Campania, linking the fifth trumpet, Apollyon, and the legion dedicated to Apollo. The study closes with map analysis of Rome and Vesuvius, the number 666, Crete’s connection to Vespasian and Titus, and the world that followed after the Messiah.
